subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu preserve omitted allowBots as accept-by-default for bot-authored group messages, or should bot admission require explicit allowBots like stricter sibling channels?
rationale: The code can implement either policy, but choosing the default changes existing Feishu upgrade behavior and production bot-pair traffic semantics.

options.title: Preserve Feishu Default After Refresh
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored events to preserve current Feishu behavior, relying on self-filtering and loop protection as the upgrade guard.

options.title: Require Explicit Bot Admission
options.body: Change Feishu so operators must set allowBots true or mentions before bot-authored events can dispatch, matching the stricter sibling-channel posture.

options.title: Pause Until Policy Is Owned
options.body: Leave the PR open but do not merge until the Feishu channel owner decides the permanent bot-admission contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve Feishu Default After Refresh
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored events to preserve current Feishu behavior, relying on self-filtering and loop protection as the upgrade guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu channel and release/config history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the default and upgrade behavior decision.
